connectors.refdes: Electronics must meet RepRap Interface Standard RIS 1 · implementation alternatives retained
connectors.form: Standard feature set, not a named or fitted board connector map
connectors.scope: The Huxley design page says any electronics meeting RIS 1 can be used. RIS 1 defines controller capabilities (including support for at least four steppers, at least three RIS 2 endstops, one thermistor and one heater) but explicitly does not define single-board versus distributed implementation, operating voltage or particular installed wiring. This context does not prove a fitted controller or Huxley machine pinout.

connectors.refdes: RIS 2 endstop connector reference · conditional on RIS 1-compliant electronics
connectors.form: Molex KK100-compatible 3-pin header reference; 2.54 mm spacing; not a fitted board view
connectors.scope: The Huxley page accepts any electronics meeting RIS 1, which requires at least three RIS 2-compliant endstop interfaces. RIS 2 shows the standard reference order Vs | GND | Vcc but does not assign numeric pin numbers. The Huxley page does not identify a fitted controller, axis-to-header map, switches, harnesses or conductor continuity. These are conditional standard reference labels only; all SmoothieBox routes remain OPEN.

Only motor types/counts and conditional RIS 2 connector reference positions are sourced; no fitted board, machine-specific contact schedule, switch harness or SmoothieBox route is established.
